jordan: Quick PM-238 follow-up: two recurring issues surfaced in the postmortem — short eviction spikes causing latency and brief 500 storms when rollouts overlap. Need concise runbook edits, clear owner assignments, and an escalation flow thats easy to skim during an incident.

kate: Yea, the full playbook is too dense mid-incident. Can we add a 2-line "fast path" and a 1-paragraph troubleshooting checklist?

sam: I can lead the eviction pattern remediation (collect traces, map to model variants, propose mitigation). Will produce a remediation plan + actionable steps. ETA: Wed EOD.

leo: Ill create the fast-path cuecard and drop exact commands used in triage. Will aim to keep it <=6 lines.

maria: Proposed escalation lanes: 1) on-call pager -> 2) runtime eng (model/runtime) -> 3) infra (node/cluster) -> 4) incident exec if P0 > 30m. Ill update the diagram and include contact rotation links.

jordan: Good. Add the condition for exec escalation and include a link to the rotation. Keep language minimal.

leo: Draft cuecard to insert, feedback pls:
```
1) Check system: metrics (inference.tokens/sec, runtime.queue_depth, runtime.evictions.count)
2) Quick pod health: `kubectl get pods -l app=runtime -n inference -o wide`
3) If evictions spike, capture debug dump: `curl -s http://localhost:8080/debug/evictions` and `journalctl -u runtime -n 200`
4) If 5xxs rise during rollout -> rollback to previous variant and scale replicas to stable count
5) Escalate per lane; enable traffic-shed if latency > SLO for >5m (`/infra traffic-shed on`)
```

kate: Add a bullet for toggling autoscaler mode: `/infra autoscale set conservative` and when to flip it. Also, include the exact alert name to silence when rolling back.

sam: Action items summary: [sam] PM-238-REM: remediation doc + logs/repro steps (due Wed EOD). [leo] cuecard + commands (due Tue). [maria] escalation diagram + rotation links (due Fri). [kate] autoscale/traffic-shed quick checklist + alert names (due Tue).

incident-bot: Created ticket PM-238-REM-1 assigned to sam, due 2026-03-25.

jordan: Ill check status Friday and schedule a 30-min sync if any blockers. If anyone finishes early, post a short note here.

maria: Also want a detection rule for the eviction pattern (alert group inference.eviction-patterns). Ill draft a sample signal: > 3 eviction spikes across different pods within 10m AND sustained queue_depth > X.

sam: Will include required logs, repro steps, and suggested mitigations in the ticket so on-call can act immediately.

leo: Once edits are in, Ill ping for quick approval. Plan: keep the playbook top section scannable and preserve full docs for deep-dive.

kate: :thumbsup: small targeted edits will reduce cognitive load during incidents.

jordan: Thanks everyone. Closing this thread, will reopen if anything slips.
